cats.name: KET
cats.whoIsTheCat: KET is an original cartoon cat, not a real pet: a round-headed white cat with one patch over his ear (black in the flat logo, warm brown in the 3D films) and heavy-lidded, unimpressed eyes. He was made for a pump.fun coin on Solana in early July 2026, which the community now runs as a takeover (ketcto). The artist has not been named.

virality.summary: KET is a July 2026 Solana meme that grew by making content. It started with a flat black-and-white cat face on red and one blunt motto, 'don't be a pussy', printed across every project page. On 22 Jul 2026, about 16 days in, KCEX listed it and a Solana commentator counted 1,902 holders; CoinGecko dates its peak to 25 Jul. The community then built Ketflix, a streaming-style site with 168 short KET videos (sagas, skits, degen reels) starring a fuzzy 3D KET, including AI parodies of well-known Solana figures, plus a meme archive and a PFP dressing room. A September post syndicated by KuCoin summed it up: 'trying to turn one extremely simple cat into a recognizable internet IP'.

cats.lore: KET is a round-headed white cat with a single patch over one ear and half-closed eyes that have already seen it all. He arrived on Solana in July 2026 as 'a cat with no plan and no fear', and his community took it from there. Instead of a roadmap, KET got a film career: Ketflix streams short sagas and skits starring a fuzzy 3D KET in office shirts and sweaters, a meme archive keeps his best moments, and a dressing room lets fans put him in any outfit. His own site's verdict: he'll wear anything. He won't like it.

cats.name: MANEKI
cats.whoIsTheCat: The maneki-neko ('beckoning cat') is a Japanese lucky-cat figurine, traditionally a calico Japanese Bobtail with one paw raised, known since Edo-period Tokyo; one legend places it at Gotoku-ji temple in Setagaya. MANEKI's cat is an original white cartoon lucky cat with red ears, a red collar and a gold bell, launched on Solana on 22 Apr 2024. Its artist is not named.

virality.summary: The figurine has beckoned customers into Japanese shops for well over a century (Wikipedia cites an 1852 record). The Solana MANEKI was one of the fastest cat coins of spring 2024: within three days Lookonchain reported a rise of more than 30,000%, SolanaFloor said it had passed $240M in market value and, on 26 Apr 2024, flipped dogwifhat in 24h on-chain volume, and Gate.io, Poloniex and MEXC listed it (AMBCrypto). In autumn 2024 it moved into football: SSC Napoli named it a European crypto partner (27 Sep 2024), and Sheffield United made it principal partner and shirt sponsor for 2024/25, with the cat on the Blades' shirts from 18 Oct 2024 against Leeds, billed as the first meme coin shirt sponsorship. In Aug 2025 the team said its MANEKI trademarks were registered.

cats.lore: Maneki is the beckoning cat of Japanese shop counters: a white lucky cat with one paw raised to wave good fortune in through the door. The best-known legend sets it at Gotoku-ji temple in Edo-era Tokyo, where a cat beckoned a passing lord inside moments before a storm broke. The Solana MANEKI keeps the classic look, red ears, a red collar and a gold bell, and adds a blissful closed-eye smile. Since April 2024 it has waved from Solana and, for the 2024/25 season, from the red-and-white shirts of Sheffield United.

cats.name: Loaf Token
cats.catName: Loafy, the cat that is also a loaf of bread
cats.whoIsTheCat: Loafy is an original cartoon made for the Cronos coin LOAF in May 2024: an orange tabby drawn as a sliced bread loaf. He riffs on the 'catloaf', the paws-tucked sitting pose that has had that name since at least 1999 (Usenet) and became a big meme on Reddit, Twitter and Facebook in the 2010s. He is not a real cat, and the artist is not named.

virality.summary: LOAF rides one of the internet's oldest cat jokes. 'Catloaf' is the pose of a cat sitting with paws and tail tucked under so it looks like a loaf of bread; GreatPetCare traces the word to Usenet in 1999 and a meme wave on Reddit, Twitter and Facebook in the 2010s, and Wikipedia's 'Cats and the Internet' article has a section on it. LOAF turned the pose into a character, Loafy, launched on Cronos in May 2024 (site recipe: 40% presale, 15% burns, 40% liquidity, 5% community) and built Toast-off, a tap-to-earn toast-making game run from Telegram that reached a second season (X banner). It trades on VVS Finance and Crypto.com Exchange (CoinGecko tickers). No single viral post for the character was found.

cats.lore: Every cat person knows the loaf: paws and tail tucked out of sight, body a tidy rectangle, a pose people have called a 'catloaf' since the 1990s. Loafy takes the joke all the way. He is an orange tabby who is also, literally, a loaf of bread: a golden crust for a back, a soft crumb face, a striped tail poking out of the end and a very smug grin. He has lived on Cronos since May 2024, where fans play Toast-off, a tap game about making toast to keep Loafy happy. His own summary: 'It's a cat that's also a loaf of bread. That's it.'

cats.lore: BOXY is a small orange cat who found a cardboard box and decided it would make a very good head. 'Box outside. Cat inside.' Nobody hired him and nobody knows how he got into the warehouse, but he has the keys to the whole place and the title Head of Empty Boxes. His listed skills: fits, sits, ships absolutely nothing. He turned up on Robinhood Chain in September 2026, where every coin on his launchpad walks side by side with a stock token, and he picked the company that sends the boxes. The blue tape stays on. The work can wait.
